=WITH prefiltered AS (
  SELECT
    u.user_id,
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.lender_name,
    p.product_name,
    p.interest_rate_min,
    p.min_monthly_income,
    p.has_qualitative_rules,
    u.monthly_income,
    u.credit_score,
    u.age,
    u.employment_status,
    CASE
      WHEN p.min_monthly_income IS NOT NULL AND p.min_monthly_income > 0 THEN
        ROUND(((u.monthly_income - p.min_monthly_income) / p.min_monthly_income) * 100, 2)
      ELSE 0
    END AS income_margin_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN p.min_credit_score IS NOT NULL THEN
        u.credit_score - p.min_credit_score
      ELSE 50
    END AS score_margin
  FROM users u
  CROSS JOIN loan_products p
  WHERE u.batch_id = '{{ $('Webhook Trigger (loan-match)').first().json.body.batch_id }}'::uuid
    AND p.is_active = TRUE
    AND (p.min_monthly_income IS NULL OR u.monthly_income >= p.min_monthly_income)
    AND (p.min_credit_score IS NULL OR u.credit_score >= p.min_credit_score)
    AND (p.max_credit_score IS NULL OR u.credit_score <= p.max_credit_score)
    AND (p.age_min IS NULL OR u.age >= p.age_min)
    AND (p.age_max IS NULL OR u.age <= p.age_max)
    AND (
      p.eligible_employment IS NULL
      OR CARDINALITY(p.eligible_employment) = 0
      OR u.employment_status = ANY(p.eligible_employment)
    )
)
INSERT INTO matches (user_id, product_id, stage, score, reason, notification_status)
SELECT
  user_id,
  product_id,
  'sql',
  score_margin,
  'Passed SQL hard criteria pre-filter',
  'pending'
FROM prefiltered
ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO NOTHING;

SELECT
  u.user_id,
  p.id AS product_id,
  p.lender_name,
  p.product_name,
  p.interest_rate_min,
  p.min_monthly_income,
  p.has_qualitative_rules,
  u.monthly_income,
  u.credit_score,
  u.age,
  u.employment_status,
  CASE
    WHEN p.min_monthly_income IS NOT NULL AND p.min_monthly_income > 0 THEN
      ROUND(((u.monthly_income - p.min_monthly_income) / p.min_monthly_income) * 100, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS income_margin_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN p.min_credit_score IS NOT NULL THEN
      u.credit_score - p.min_credit_score
    ELSE 50
  END AS score_margin
FROM users u
CROSS JOIN loan_products p
WHERE u.batch_id = '{{ $('Webhook Trigger (loan-match)').first().json.body.batch_id }}'::uuid
  AND p.is_active = TRUE
  AND (p.min_monthly_income IS NULL OR u.monthly_income >= p.min_monthly_income)
  AND (p.min_credit_score IS NULL OR u.credit_score >= p.min_credit_score)
  AND (p.max_credit_score IS NULL OR u.credit_score <= p.max_credit_score)
  AND (p.age_min IS NULL OR u.age >= p.age_min)
  AND (p.age_max IS NULL OR u.age <= p.age_max)
  AND (
    p.eligible_employment IS NULL
    OR CARDINALITY(p.eligible_employment) = 0
    OR u.employment_status = ANY(p.eligible_employment)
  );

=INSERT INTO matches (user_id, product_id, stage, score, reason, notification_status)
SELECT
  m.user_id,
  m.product_id,
  m.stage,
  m.score,
  m.reason,
  'pending'
FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ $json.sqlEscapedClearMatches }}'::jsonb) AS m(
  user_id TEXT, product_id INT, stage TEXT, score NUMERIC, reason TEXT
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  stage = EXCLUDED.stage,
  score = EXCLUDED.score,
  reason = EXCLUDED.reason;

=WITH match_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matches
  FROM matches m
  JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.user_id
  WHERE u.batch_id = '{{ $('Stage 2: Rules & Top-K Ranking').first().json.batch_id }}'::uuid
)
UPDATE upload_batches
SET
  pairs_total = {{ $('Init Batch & Count Pairs').first().json.pairs_total || 0 }},
  pairs_after_sql = {{ $('Stage 2: Rules & Top-K Ranking').first().json.pairs_after_sql || 0 }},
  pairs_after_rules = {{ $('Stage 2: Rules & Top-K Ranking').first().json.pairs_after_rules || 0 }},
  pairs_sent_to_llm = 0,
  pairs_matched = (SELECT total_matches FROM match_count),
  status = 'matching'
WHERE batch_id = '{{ $('Stage 2: Rules & Top-K Ranking').first().json.batch_id }}'::uuid;
